# Cncf Opensandbox Reviewer

Review OpenSandbox using its official documentation and repository in the Orchestration &amp; Management / Scheduling &amp; Orchestration category. OpenSandbox is a general-purpose sandbox platform for AI applications, offering multi-language SDKs, unified sandbox APIs, and Docker/Kubernetes runtimes for scenarios like Coding Agents, GUI Agents, Agent Evaluation, AI Code Execution, and RL Training.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
